scope: Real speech.cpp HTTP inference through production VoiceEventBus / VoiceRoute / AudioRouter into managed PipeWire source and VRChat desktop microphone-test replay.
status_interpretation: All raw trials are preserved, including the initial timeout. The initial crash case remains running in that raw report because the exception aborted the case; its enclosing report is failed, not an accepted case.

The crash runner uses a 12-second initial idle observation window, not a product fault-silence SLA. Host server-crash passed means eventual error/silence and route preservation within that window; its 5.1-second audio tail remains a product issue.

Private diagnostic preserves failed status when 12 seconds elapse, then continues observation and recovery checks. Its 15.8-second result and the host result are different environments, not one latency distribution.
No production fix for failure detection is included in this change.

boundaries.start: SpeechMessageEvent.timestamp_ns created by test harness; not VRCT GUI input
boundaries.first_http_pcm: First PCM frame returned by real SpeechCppTTS; may contain zeros
boundaries.first_source_audio: ToneCapture 20 ms source read frame with peak >64/32768; read timestamp, not ADC timestamp
boundaries.silence: First source read of the continuously silent interval, confirmed for at least two seconds; reader liveness checked
boundaries.precision: Host scheduling and 20 ms capture frames limit timing resolution; many decimal places are not physical precision
boundaries.column_differences: Include leading silence and different nonzero thresholds; not pure OS transport delay
boundaries.vrchat_replay: Reference is PCM generated for the same request, compared by envelope against virtual mic and dedicated VRChat playback capture

host_preparation.ui: VRChat desktop Japanese; noise suppression OFF; microphone volume 75%, threshold 10%
host_preparation.gui_templates: Taken from the current displayed UI; initial menus prepared and inspected before automated sequence

setup_observations: An initial metadata query could not find process ID on a node; setup aborted before mutation and was corrected by resolving client.id.
The device list order differed from the previous test. P1 monitor was selected once, then corrected to managed source and graph-verified before any test audio.
Initial cleanup refused two remaining sink inputs; inspection established both were daemon-owned managed TTS/VC loopbacks to the managed mix. Cleanup then proceeded for those owned streams.
